observations.evidence: S/N have a visibly designed terminal: rounded crowned cap, narrow seat, substantial vertical shaft, raised face field and resolved ground shoe. The coping disappears into the post cleanly. This is a meaningful native construction improvement over the original thin bar. E/W retain coherent real depth; the cap, shaft and foot remain legible rather than exposing a neglected reverse face.

The softened blue coping is distinct from honey timber. Broad grain follows the wall horizontally and the S/N shaft vertically. The post base retains warm brown midtones on light, gray and dark backgrounds, avoiding the source dark-base dead spot.

Broad edge shading gives the cap, wood panels and coping volume without glare or a white painted perimeter. The W post has a broad darker middle band but remains warm, readable and continuous with its foot; it is not a black patch or unresolved overlap. All actual facings maintain a coherent soft finish and no ground cast shadow is visible.

The terminal cap/seat/foot and face fields support its finished-end role. The broad stylized grain is visible at logical size and is controlled enough to preserve material separation. No unrelated ornament or noisy microtexture is needed to establish the improvement.

At full registered logical 192x352, S/N immediately read as a low wall with one finished post. E/W remain naturally narrow under the fixed camera; their end and open-profile forms stay deliberate. The native and logical alpha silhouettes are clean, with the free end visible in all assemblies.

Inspected native and independently assembled W joins in every facing, whole RGB on three backgrounds, whole alpha, enlarged seam RGB/alpha and difference views. Blue silhouette/radiance, timber levels and grain remain continuous across W; there is no visible slit, doubled ridge, exposed cut strip, material phase reset or alpha break at intended size. The native/independent differences are small shading/edge variations rather than a material seam.

No material clipping, missing surface, black overlap patch, broken bevel, exposed buried termination, stray alpha speck, halo or unwanted shadow found in the four native captures or declared assemblies. Enlarged inspection shows fine native render grain but no defect that harms logical use.

remainingDifferences: The native result has a quieter, more matte ceramic and timber finish than the glossy imagegen target, with broad soft highlights. This satisfies the warm-soft family finish and keeps form readable.

The terminal cap is a compact soft crown inside height1.02 rather than the target tall stacked cap. Its seat, shaft, face fields and foot make a coherent finished construction within the locked envelope.

The horizontal wall divisions follow the locked family band contract rather than copying the target exact board count. The four real rotations and registered occupied scale take precedence over the single concept view.
The narrow W-facing post side has subtler grain than the S/N front/back faces. Its shape, base and material remain readable, so this is an accepted view-dependent material difference.
